name: guavagrade
description: Read your GuavaGrade website reports and fix the problems in your site's code.

defaultPrompt: Use GuavaGrade to fix the top problems in my website report.
Use GuavaGrade to find and fix the accessibility issues on my site.
Use GuavaGrade to explain my website's grades.
